title: Promise and Songbook
author: Sebastian Thackeray
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
